reports.weather: Light rain outside; interior work area dry at start
reports.work_planned: Remove water-damaged concrete flooring and prepare substrate for replacement.
reports.work_completed: Removed approximately 18 m2 of flooring in Room B104. Debris placed in designated container. Exposed substrate photographed.
reports.materials_equipment: Concrete saw, breaker, dust extraction, debris cart
reports.issue_or_update: Water damage was observed near the east wall. The source has not been confirmed. No standing water remained at the start of the shift.
reports.schedule_status: Removal is progressing; substrate inspection required before replacement pour.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: CO-01 referenced; no RFI number listed
reports.action_required: GC to confirm removal boundary and arrange substrate inspection before pour preparation.
reports.supporting_evidence: Photos B104-0511-01 to B104-0511-04 listed; not attached in this synthetic record

reports.work_planned: Coordinate repair scope and confirm area ready for replacement concrete.
reports.work_completed: Daily coordination walk completed. Superintendent noted that the flooring removal area appeared ready for base preparation.
reports.issue_or_update: The report says the area is ready for base preparation, but does not record a substrate inspection, acceptance, or sign-off.
reports.schedule_status: Base preparation may proceed, subject to confirmation of inspection requirements.
reports.action_required: Confirm whether the substrate inspection has occurred and record acceptance before the pour.

reports.work_planned: Complete base preparation and place replacement concrete if area is released.
reports.work_completed: Base preparation completed over approximately 18 m2. No concrete placed.
reports.issue_or_update: Crew was told verbally at 07:20 that the area was cleared to proceed. No written release or inspection record was available at the workface.
reports.schedule_status: Pour postponed pending written confirmation of substrate acceptance and approved placement details.
reports.action_required: GC/Quality Inspector to issue written release and confirm RFI-017 response status.
reports.responsible_party: General Contractor / Quality Inspector / Design Team
reports.quantity_or_measurement: 18 m2 base preparation; 0 m3 concrete placed
reports.supporting_evidence: Crew foreman notes verbal instruction; no signed inspection form attached

reports.work_planned: Resolve inspection status and coordinate concrete placement.
reports.work_completed: Coordination call held with concrete subcontractor. Superintendent's notes state: 'Inspection passed this morning.'
reports.issue_or_update: No inspector name, inspection time, checklist, or written acceptance is referenced. The subcontractor's report for the same day states that written release was still outstanding at 15:30.
reports.schedule_status: Report indicates inspection passed; subcontractor records indicate pour remains on hold.
reports.action_required: Reconcile inspection status with the inspector and subcontractor; circulate the signed release and confirm whether RFI-017 is answered.
reports.supporting_evidence: Call notes only; no inspection record attached

reports.work_planned: Place replacement concrete after receipt of approved release and mix details.
reports.work_completed: No concrete placed. Crew completed edge cleaning and staged reinforcement materials outside the work area.
reports.materials_equipment: Reinforcement materials staged; concrete pump not mobilized
reports.issue_or_update: At 10:15, foreman checked with the GC. Written inspection release had not been received. RFI-017 asks whether the replacement slab should match the original thickness or revised detail; no response was available to the crew.
reports.schedule_status: Pour postponed for a second shift. Crew reassigned for part of the afternoon.
reports.action_required: Issue inspection release and provide written response to RFI-017 before rescheduling the pour.
reports.responsible_party: General Contractor / Quality Inspector / Design Team
reports.supporting_evidence: Foreman log; no formal response attached

reports.work_planned: Review RFI and confirm repair scope.
reports.work_completed: RFI-017 reviewed internally. Engineer's note says 'use original detail' but the response was not transmitted through the formal RFI system.
reports.issue_or_update: Internal note may be interpreted as a decision, but there is no formally issued response or confirmation that the subcontractor received it.
reports.schedule_status: Subcontractor may remain on hold until formal response is distributed.
reports.action_required: Issue the formal RFI response, confirm receipt, and identify the applicable drawing revision.
reports.supporting_evidence: Internal engineering note; formal response not attached

reports.work_completed: Inspection completed at 08:10. Substrate accepted for placement subject to using the approved slab detail and documenting reinforcement placement. Signed checklist recorded as QC-B104-0514.
reports.issue_or_update: The signed checklist confirms substrate acceptance, but does not resolve the slab thickness question in RFI-017.
reports.schedule_status: Substrate inspection closed; pour still depends on design clarification and reinforcement verification.
reports.action_required: Design Team to issue formal slab detail; subcontractor to request reinforcement inspection before placement.

reports.work_planned: Place replacement concrete after design and inspection release.
reports.work_completed: Reinforcement placed over the prepared area. No concrete placed.
reports.issue_or_update: Crew received a message from the GC saying 'detail should be the same as before.' The message did not identify a drawing number or revision, and RFI-017 still appeared open in the system.
reports.schedule_status: Pour not started. Reinforcement inspection requested but not yet completed.
reports.action_required: Confirm approved drawing revision and complete reinforcement inspection before placement.
reports.responsible_party: General Contractor / Design Team / Quality Inspector
reports.supporting_evidence: Message referenced but not attached; no reinforcement inspection record

reports.work_planned: Coordinate concrete placement and adjacent trade access.
reports.work_completed: Concrete placement completed. Delivery tickets list 4.2 m3 supplied. Pour began at 09:05 and finishing was completed by 12:40. Adjacent electrical subcontractor was notified to avoid the area until protection was removed.
reports.materials_equipment: Concrete pump; delivery tickets CT-771 and CT-772
reports.issue_or_update: Report states the pour used the approved detail, but does not cite the drawing revision or attach the formal RFI-017 response. Reinforcement inspection reference is listed as RI-B104-0515.
reports.schedule_status: Placement completed; curing/protection and strength-test follow-up remain in progress.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: CO-01; RFI-017 listed as 'resolved' by superintendent; RI-B104-0515
reports.action_required: Attach formal RFI response and reinforcement inspection record; maintain curing/protection; notify adjacent trades when access is safe.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: 4.2 m3 delivered; placed quantity not separately measured
reports.supporting_evidence: Delivery tickets referenced; RFI response not attached

reports.work_planned: Complete electrical rough-in in corridor adjacent to concrete repair area.
reports.work_completed: Crew stopped work near Room B104 from 09:00 to 12:45 while concrete placement and finishing activities restricted access. Crew moved to another corridor and resumed work there.
reports.issue_or_update: The report records a temporary access restriction but does not identify who issued the restriction or whether the electrical foreman received advance notice.
reports.schedule_status: No full-shift delay reported; local work sequence changed.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: No RFI or change order referenced
reports.action_required: GC to confirm access notification procedure for adjacent trades and record any verified schedule impact.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Approximately 3 hours 45 minutes of restricted access

originalFindings.title: Substrate Inspection Documentation Discrepancy and Resolution
originalFindings.observation: GC Superintendent reported substrate area ready for base preparation without formal inspection sign-off (DR-A02, DR-A04), while Subcontractor recorded lack of written release (DR-A03, DR-A05); resolution achieved via signed checklist QC-B104-0514 referenced in Quality Inspector report (DR-A07).
originalFindings.consequence: Work progress was contingent on formal acceptance despite verbal instructions; historical discrepancy noted for retrospective audit.
originalFindings.action: Retrospective confirmation that substrate inspection QC-B104-0514 matches work records to validate closeout documentation.

evidence.quote: The report says the area is ready for base preparation, but does not record a substrate inspection, acceptance, or sign-off.
GC/Quality Inspector to issue written release and confirm RFI-017 response status.
Signed checklist QC-B104-0514 referenced

originalFindings.title: RFI-017 Design Detail Formal Response Missing
originalFindings.observation: Design Team internal note indicated use of original detail (DR-A06), but formal response was not transmitted to Subcontractor until pour, and DR-A09 final report claims RFI-017 resolved without attaching the formal response document.
originalFindings.consequence: Concrete placement proceeded based on unverified design authorization in the closeout file record.
originalFindings.action: Design Team to locate and attach formal RFI-017 response to project archive; verify subcontractor receipt of approved drawing revision prior to placement.

evidence.quote: Internal note may be interpreted as a decision, but there is no formally issued response or confirmation that the subcontractor received it.
Message referenced but not attached; no reinforcement inspection record
CO-01; RFI-017 listed as 'resolved' by superintendent; RI-B104-0515

originalFindings.title: Reinforcement Inspection Record Omitted from Closeout Documentation
originalFindings.observation: Reinforcement inspection reference RI-B104-0515 was listed in Concrete Subcontractor final report (DR-A09) but the signed checklist or photo evidence was not attached to the file, preventing verification of physical readiness compliance.
originalFindings.consequence: Record incompleteness prevents audit confirmation that reinforcement placement met quality requirements prior to pour completion.
originalFindings.action: Request QC records for RI-B104-0515 inspection; confirm reinforcement installation details match approved design revision before final sign-off.

evidence.quote: Substrate inspection closed; pour still depends on design clarification and reinforcement verification.
Message referenced but not attached; no reinforcement inspection record
Delivery tickets referenced; RFI response not attached

originalFindings.title: RFI-017 Design Decision Transmission and Slab Detail Clarification
originalFindings.observation: The replacement slab thickness and detail design query for RFI-017 remained open in the system through May 2026, though a Superintendent noted resolution on the final pour without attaching the formal RFI response or drawing revision.
originalFindings.consequence: Lack of a formally transmitted design decision and attached record prevents audit closure and relies on internal notes rather than approved shop drawings for the replacement slab detail.
originalFindings.action: Attach formal RFI response to verify the approved slab detail and resolve the technical query before closing out the concern.
originalFindings.uncertainty: Confidence is limited by missing attachment of the formal RFI-017 response despite claims of resolution in daily reports.

evidence.quote: At 10:15, foreman checked with the GC. Written inspection release had not been received. RFI-017 asks whether the replacement slab should match the original thickness or revised detail; no response was available to the crew.
RFI-017 reviewed internally. Engineer's note says 'use original detail' but the response was not transmitted through the formal RFI system.
Crew received a message from the GC saying 'detail should be the same as before.' The message did not identify a drawing number or revision, and RFI-017 still appeared open in the system.
Attach formal RFI response and reinforcement inspection record; maintain curing/protection; notify adjacent trades when access is safe.

originalFindings.title: Concrete Pour Postponement and Completion
originalFindings.observation: Concrete work for replacement in Room B104 was postponed from May 12 to May 15 due to missing written inspection release and RFI-017 status conflicts, then completed after verification on May 15.
originalFindings.consequence: Work schedule impacted by administrative hold; physical completion achieved after documentation gap reconciliation.
originalFindings.action: Verify delay duration impact against project baseline if required for claims history.
originalFindings.uncertainty: RFI-017 response attached status uncertain in A09 despite claim of resolution; internal note in A06 suggests decision made but formal system response missing.

evidence.quote: Pour postponed pending written confirmation of substrate acceptance and approved placement details.
Pour postponed for a second shift. Crew reassigned for part of the afternoon.

Concrete placement completed. Delivery tickets list 4.2 m3 supplied. Pour began at 09:05 and finishing was completed by 12:40. Adjacent electrical subcontractor was notified to avoid the area until protection was removed.

originalFindings.title: Concrete Delivery versus Installed Quantity
originalFindings.observation: Delivery tickets recorded 4.2 m3 supplied on May 15, but the daily report did not separately measure the installed quantity.
originalFindings.consequence: Installed quantity cannot be definitively distinguished from delivery waste or return material without separate measurement record.
originalFindings.action: Obtain weigh-off records or pour logs to reconcile delivered versus placed volume.
originalFindings.uncertainty: Placed quantity not separately measured per A09; waste or return untracked.

evidence.quote: 4.2 m3 delivered; placed quantity not separately measured

originalFindings.title: Curing Protection and Strength Test Follow-up
originalFindings.observation: Curing/protection and strength-test follow-up were explicitly noted as remaining in progress after concrete placement on May 15.
originalFindings.consequence: Structural readiness or testing completion not documented until these tasks are finished.
originalFindings.action: Track curing schedule completion and test report issuance for closeout file.
originalFindings.uncertainty: No later report confirms completion of curing or strength tests within the provided data.

evidence.quote: Report states the pour used the approved detail, but does not cite the drawing revision or attach the formal RFI-017 response. Reinforcement inspection reference is listed as RI-B104-0515.

originalFindings.title: Unknown Cause of Observed Water Damage
originalFindings.observation: Water damage observed in Room B104 near the east wall with source unconfirmed after substrate removal.
originalFindings.consequence: Source uncertainty may affect remediation scope and moisture history assessment before repair.
originalFindings.action: Investigate potential leak sources or roof/wall penetration points to confirm water entry point.
originalFindings.uncertainty: The source of the water damage has not been confirmed in the daily records.

evidence.quote: Water damage was observed near the east wall. The source has not been confirmed. No standing water remained at the start of the shift.

originalFindings.title: Uncertain Access Coordination for Adjacent Electrical Trade
originalFindings.observation: Electrical subcontractor work stopped in adjacent corridor during concrete pour activities with uncertainty about notification procedure.
originalFindings.consequence: Electrical progress affected by temporary access restriction without confirmed advance notice documentation.
originalFindings.action: Verify the notification method and timing of access restrictions for adjacent trade schedules.
originalFindings.uncertainty: The daily reports do not identify who issued the restriction or confirm receipt of notice by the electrical foreman.
